Description: FLASHRUSH isolated lab; admin dashboard API

AdminApiKey.Description: Admin API bearer secret. Supply via FLASHRUSH_ADMIN_API_KEY; never commit it.

Properties.Name: flashrush-lab-spa-rewrite

FunctionConfig.Comment: Rewrite application routes only; preserve asset errors

Properties.FunctionCode: function handler(event) { var r = event.request; if (/^\/(staff|products|checkout|orders|admin|monitoring|cart|account|auth|account)(\/.*)?$/.test(r.uri) && !/\.[^/]+$/.test(r.uri)) { r.uri = '/index.html'; } return r; }
